mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS name, p.cover_img AS coverImg, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, SUM(s.qty) AS sales7d, (SELECT MIN(IF(k.is_discount = 1 AND k.discount_price IS NOT NULL, k.discount_price, k.price)) FROM tb_sku k WHERE k.product_id = p.id AND k.status = 1 AND k.deleted = 0) AS minPrice FROM tb_product p JOIN tb_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN tb_product_sales_stat s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.shelf_status = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.cover_img, c.id, c.name, c.sort ORDER BY c.sort ASC, sales7d DESC
